subject.title: fix(approvals): fail closed plugin tool gates

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally make deprecated plugin `timeoutBehavior: "allow"` ineffective for existing plugins now, accepting the compatibility break to enforce fail-closed execution?
rationale: The implementation enforces a sound authorization invariant, but automation cannot accept the upgrade impact of removing a previously documented execution fallback.

options.title: Fail closed now
options.body: Ignore the deprecated field at runtime, document the intentional break, and require every unresolved plugin approval to deny.

options.title: Stage the cutover
options.body: Preserve allow-on-timeout temporarily while providing a defined deprecation or migration window before strict enforcement.

recommendation.title: Fail closed now
recommendation.body: Ignore the deprecated field at runtime, document the intentional break, and require every unresolved plugin approval to deny.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history shows direct ownership of the approval transaction and plugin gate surfaces involved in this choice.
